t: This is the Kiln Theatre, a theatre and cinema in Kilburn, in the London Borough of Brent. Since 1980 it has put on a wide range of plays reflecting the cultural diversity of the area, along with new writing, political work, and verbatim reconstructions of public inquiries. It was founded by two Canadians, the writer Shirley Barrie and the theatre director Ken Chubb. Barrie also co-founded the Wakefield Tricycle Company, and the theatre was originally known as the Tricycle Theatre.
